verdict.rationale: Foreloop ships an npm package (@foreloop/feedback) and a documented CLI with stable --json output and MCP support for agents, which count as official SDK/interface surfaces, but there is no evidence of a broader multi-language SDK (e.g., Python, Go) or SDK-specific reference docs beyond the single JS widget package and CLI. missing for 10: dedicated SDK reference documentation, multi-language SDK support, independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
